result.instructions: Tools for eGestor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are still open and due this month?"; "List my sales from last week with totals."; "Which products do I sell, and at what price?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes eGestor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run egestor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run egestor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run egestor_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. egestor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: egestor_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customers, suppliers and carriers. Good first call to find a contact code. eGestor API: GET /v1/contatos.

filtro.description: Text search over the main fields of the record.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

tools.name: egestor_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get full data of one contact by code. eGestor API: GET /v1/contatos/{codigo}.

codigo.description: The record code (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: egestor_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (customer, supplier or carrier) in eGestor. This writes data and is not idempotent: calling it twice creates two contacts. Returns the new code. eGestor API: POST /v1/contatos.
